name: NORDIC denoising (Python)
summary: Denoises BOLD fMRI from magnitude and phase data with NORDIC (locally low-rank PCA) using the NORDIC-python translation, and outputs the denoised magnitude BOLD.
description: Runs run_nordic.py from NORDIC-python, which estimates g-factor noise maps with an MPPCA pass and applies locally low-rank denoising. Use it on raw complex-valued BOLD before other preprocessing. Needs matching magnitude and phase series. NORDIC is licensed for non-profit research and educational use only.

inputs.description: Phase BOLD time series matching the magnitude.

parameters.description: Temporal phase correction mode (see upstream docs).

failure_modes.fix: Check that the magnitude and phase inputs match and the NORDIC log for errors.
